primary_sources.evidence_note: SEC Form 8-K dated 2026-10-23: Evernorth may, at its sole discretion and subject to conditions, direct CF Principal Investments LLC (Cantor) to purchase up to 5,218,935 newly issued Class A shares. Purchase price is 97% of applicable VWAP, subject to 4.99% beneficial-ownership and 20% trading-volume limits. A $521,893.50 cash commitment fee is fully earned and non-refundable regardless of purchases.

evidence_notes: SEC Form 424B3 dated 2026-10-30: up to approximately $76.8 million in aggregate gross proceeds is a conditional illustration assuming all 5,218,935 shares are sold at the cover-page closing price. It is not reported cash received. The facility remains subject to purchase notices, conditions and share/volume limits.

SEC Form 424B3: the $30.0 million Convertible Senior PIK Notes were funded on 2026-10-12. The prospectus describes approximately $30.0 million of proceeds before transaction expenses; the financial-statement note reports $29.0 million net cash after a $1.0 million capital-markets-advisor fee.
Full-document exact phrase search for actual capital in the SEC 424B3 returned no matching text.

primary_sources.evidence_note: The preliminary prospectus illustrates up to approximately $80.7M of potential gross proceeds using the October 22, 2026 closing price of $15.46 and the maximum 5,218,935-share commitment; it is conditional, not cash received.
